description:
Breezy brings music search, mood radio and personal mixes to iPhone and iPad.

Find your next listen
Search for songs, albums, artists and playlists. Explore 34 mood and genre radio stations, from Late night and Workout to Lo-fi and Golden oldies. Radio and discovery adapt to your listening. Set an era preference and add up to four artist hints, or start with none. Adjust Listening languages and Discovery balance in Settings. These preferences guide discovery rather than limit every song.

Keep music on your Home Screen
Add Recently played, Liked songs or Mix widgets in small, medium and large sizes. Choose Daily Mix or Discover Weekly, browse saved music and open Breezy to play it. Recent-song actions can resume your saved position. Widget refresh timing is managed by iOS.

Make room for your favorites
Build playlists, save liked songs and follow artists for new releases. Search within saved songs and playlists, return through Recently opened, or save your current queue as a new playlist. Arrange Home around the sections you use and explore Daily Mix and Discover Weekly. See a personal recap over the past week, month or year. Artist pages include collaborations, with song-language filters and corrections on popular-song lists. Album descriptions appear when supplied.

Listen your way
Keep the mini-player close while browsing. Open the full player for your queue, lyrics and the Album and artists chooser. AirPlay opens Apple's audio-output control. Read lyrics when available and tap timed lines to seek. Choose Random or Fewer repeats for new shuffles, set a sleep timer or adjust gapless playback and Autoplay. Crossfade defaults to 0 seconds and Automix defaults off. Choose from 7 original app icons, seven accent colors and light, dark or system appearance.

Cached songs, available offline
Open Cached songs to find complete, compatible audio already on this device. Play and seek without a connection while those files remain cached. Likes and playlist saves do not download audio. Storage controls let you inspect and remove cached songs; these are temporary files, not permanent downloads.

Your library and iCloud
Your library is saved on your device. iCloud sync starts on when this device has no saved sync setting; a saved Off choice stays off. Sync requires iCloud Drive and the same Apple Account on your devices, and you can turn it off in Settings. Current playback, cached media, sign-in and tip records stay on each device. Device backups may also include your library.

Music and lyrics depend on external providers and your connection. Song play counts, where supplied, are provider snapshots. Audio quality varies by source. Breezy uses an unofficial YouTube Music integration and is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

Optional one-time tips through Apple support development and unlock no features or music.
promotionalText: Keep favorites and mixes on your Home Screen. Explore radio shaped by your listening, search saved music and return to fully cached songs offline.
